messages:
carolyn: Quick follow-up from the PM: we still need owners for customer comms and a short policy for RCA sharing. Who can pick up the statuspage blurb and customer summary?

mike: I can do the 1-2 paragraph customer summary. Draft: 
"At 14:12 UTC we experienced a partial degradation affecting some hosted inference requests. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity and service recovered by 14:45 UTC. A sanitized summary and next steps will be published within 7 days."

sudha: Good — use 'partial degradation' instead of outage. Iwill include pattern notes in the full RCA (two prior slow failovers tied to KV cache pressure).

elaine: Legal note: public posts must not contain customer IDs or internal ticket numbers. Proposal: tiered sharing policy where Level A gets a sanitized public RCA + tailored addendum for impacted customers; Level B gets short public summary and internal RCA; Level C internal-only.

tony: I'll own the statuspage edit and publish within 24h. Mike, drop your draft in #incidents-drafts and I'll push after review.

mike: Posted draft in #incidents-drafts: https://slack.redwood/drafts/1764201180

carolyn: Action items & ETAs:
- Statuspage blurb: owner=tony, ETA=24h
- Customer summary (1-2 paragraphs): owner=mike, ETA=48h
- Full internal RCA + pattern analysis: owner=sudha, ETA=7d
- RCA sharing policy & legal confirmation: owner=elaine, ETA=3d
- RCA sanitization template: owners=mike+elaine, ETA=5d

ops-bot: INC-2026-489: internal RCA doc created (access restricted).

mike: Quick Q: when a customer requests more detail, do we send the internal doc or a sanitized artifact?

elaine: Send a sanitized artifact by default. Escalate to legal/sales for regulated or contractually obligated releases.

sudha: If recurring pattern confirmed, recommend adding fixes to Redwood Optimize suggestions and Dedicated autoscale rules. I'll include that in the 7-day RCA.

carolyn: I'll file a recurring-pattern ticket and link remediation backlog.

tony: Posting status gently: use cautious language; don't promise ongoing investigations unless active. I'll include an FAQ line: "Impacted customers will receive an email with next steps."

ops-bot: Reminder: action statuspage-edit assigned to tony, due in 86400s.

carolyn: Recap: Tony publish status (24h), Mike publish short customer summary + sanitization template (48h/5d), Sudha full RCA+pattern (7d), Elaine legal policy confirmation (3d), Carolyn link recurring-pattern ticket (7d). Reassign here if needed. :thumbsup:

mike: all good

tony: posting now, will ping when live

ops-bot: Status posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation resolved. Incident summary forthcoming."

carolyn: Thanks team, closing this follow-up thread unless blockers appear.
